title: Console sidebar: open on the area that holds the current page (per-audience landing, deep links)
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw2uhdSeHYfnZdAf4V

Filing gate: ③ a contract-review finding on a seat PR: record 6551992138 on PR #28496 (#28450), should-fix ④.4, "takes a `domain:ui` card, not an acceptance note". ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reach: any app with more than one `areas[]` entry. A per-audience `landing` (#28450) that names an entry in a second area opens the right page with the first area's menu in the sidebar, so the reader sees a menu that does not contain the page they are on. A deep link or a bookmark into a second area does the same today.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui`.
Duplicate search: "sidebar active area route", "UnifiedSidebar activeAreaId" → none open. New.

## Observed (at `main` `755794fd`, code read)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx` elects `activeAreaId` as `visibleAreas[0]` on mount and re-elects only when the app or the visible-area set changes. The current route is never read, so the sidebar always opens on the first visible area.
- `@objectstack/spec` `AppLandingEntrySchema`'s docblock says "The landing is a sidebar entry, so the sidebar highlights what the reader landed on". For a target in `areas[1+]` that does not hold.

## Wanted

1. On the app's first render, and when the route changes to a page no entry of the active area addresses, the sidebar elects the visible area whose navigation holds the entry the current route addresses. With none, today's rule stands: keep the current area, else the first visible one.
2. A user's own area pick is not overridden while they stay on a page the picked area addresses.

## Tests

- A real-`UnifiedSidebar` pin: an app with two areas, the route on an entry of the second area, so the second area is active and its entry highlighted. Ablation: the election back to `visibleAreas[0]` reds it.
- A control: a route on an entry of the first area keeps the first area.

## Acceptance

Both Wanted items are pinned, or answered "will not do" with the reason. If it is not done, the spec docblock sentence is corrected instead.
